desc_ko: Shimao Services Holdings Ltd is an investment holding company mainly engaged in the provision of property management and value-added services. The Company mainly conducts three types of businesses. Property management services' property management portfolio includes residential properties and non-residential properties, such as government and public facilities, elderly-care and healthcare facilities and airport lounges. It also provides cleaning, greening and gardening, repair and maintenance services. Community value-added services offer community asset management, carpark sales related services, home improvement services, smart community solutions and other services, including housekeeping and home electronics repair and maintenance services. Value-added services to non-property owners include sales office management services, preliminary planning and design consultancy services and repair and maintenance services. The Company mainly conducts its businesses in the China market.
